name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: These swing voters in Nevada say they are not dismissing socialist candidates
changes.summary: In online focus groups, 10 of 12 Biden-to-Trump voters said they wouldn't automatically think negatively of a politician who identifies with socialism. (Image credit: Scott Olson).

changes.title: Reflecting Pool's botched repairs threaten to tarnish the National Park Service's reputation
changes.summary: President Donald Trump's handling of repairs at the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool has put the National Park Service in a difficult spot.

changes.title: Trump-Led Board Votes Again to Close Kennedy Center for Renovations
changes.summary: The decision will be reviewed by a federal judge who previously said the board had not thoroughly evaluated the president’s plan.

changes.title: ICE Agent Who Pushed Activist to the Ground Near Chicago Pleads Guilty
changes.summary: The agent, Adam Saracco, was charged with misdemeanor after the altercation at a gas station near Chicago last year during the Trump administration’s crackdown there.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has new details on the news that President Trump and other government officials took extraordinary air security measures amid threats from Iran.

changes.title: White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt to Step Down
changes.summary: President Donald Trump is announcing Karoline Leavitt will be departing as White House Press Secretary at the end of August after more than a year and half on the job. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

changes.title: Trump administration finalizes rule to end federal support for gender-affirming care
changes.summary: Move blocking funds through Medicaid and Chip to make it harder for vulnerable children to get healthcare, experts say The Trump administration finalized a rule on Tuesday to end gender-affirming care through Medicaid and the Children’s Health Insurance Program (Chip), a move that will make it harder for vulnerable chi.

changes.title: Karoline Leavitt is leaving her role as Trump's White House press secretary
changes.summary: Leavitt called it a "bittersweet decision" in a social media post Wednesday shortly after President Donald Trump announced she would be stepping down. She recently returned to the White House podium after the birth of her second child, a daughter named Viviana, in May.

changes.title: Product availability changed in Europe
changes.summary: President Trump’s Air Force One subterfuge pales in comparison to the secrecy surrounding Russia’s president, whose fixation on security has reached new heights in recent years.

changes.title: For Blakeman, Trump Could Make and Break His Bid to Lead New York
changes.summary: Bruce Blakeman, who is vying to become the state’s second Republican governor in the last 50 years, pushes President Trump’s agenda even as he avoids mentioning his name.
